title: An explicit trailing comma before the closing brace is not well-formed JSON
notes: source: WV-PORT-API-STALL-SUSPENDED-01, mutation: the bytes are exactly the literal {"version":2, (B3.1) — not derived from the seed by field-level edit, since B3.1 asks for JSON that never parses at all. normative ([WIR1-I07]'s malformed-JSON clause): observed kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException (JsonDecodingException) "Unexpected JSON token at offset 12: Trailing comma before the end of JSON object at path: $.version". Dead-letter accounting on the receiving side is covered by wire/src/test/kotlin/civictech/wire/WsIngressDecodeFailureTest.kt, not retested here.
